evals.name: 20-Point Enterprise Architecture Scaffolding & Bootstrap
evals.prompt: Bootstrap a production-grade NestJS application configuring Helmet, global ValidationPipe with whitelist, Swagger at /api/docs, and app.enableShutdownHooks().
evals.expected_output: Generates main.ts with Helmet, ValidationPipe with whitelist and transform, Swagger setup via DocumentBuilder, and enableShutdownHooks().
assertions: Configures global ValidationPipe with whitelist and transform options
Enables graceful shutdown handling via app.enableShutdownHooks
Sets up interactive Swagger documentation at /api/docs
Configures global route prefix api/v1 and security headers

evals.name: Zod Environment Validation, Exception Filter & Response Envelope
evals.prompt: Implement Zod schema environment validation, GlobalHttpExceptionFilter, and TransformResponseInterceptor for standardizing API responses.
evals.expected_output: Creates env.config.ts with Zod schema parsing, GlobalHttpExceptionFilter returning standardized error format, and TransformResponseInterceptor wrapping data in uniform envelope.
assertions: Implements validateEnv using Zod schema safeParse for runtime variables
Implements GlobalHttpExceptionFilter standardizing HTTP error status and path
Implements TransformResponseInterceptor wrapping successful payloads in ApiResponseEnvelope
Separates pagination metadata into meta property inside response envelope

evals.name: Database Lifecycle, Mandatory Pagination & Containerization
evals.prompt: Implement PrismaService with connection lifecycle hooks, PaginationQueryDto with max limit 100, and a multi-stage Dockerfile.
evals.expected_output: Creates PrismaService with OnModuleInit and OnModuleDestroy, PaginationQueryDto with skip offset getter, and multi-stage Dockerfile with non-root user.
assertions: Implements PrismaService lifecycle hooks onModuleInit and onModuleDestroy
Implements PaginationQueryDto enforcing default limit 10 and maxLimit 100
Provides multi-stage Dockerfile running as non-root node user
Enforces strict TypeScript types with zero explicit any annotations
